name: Julianna Ravinia Avary
original_name: ジュリアンナ・ラヴィニア・エイヴァリー
source:
The vice-admiral with the Union Air Force, a comrade of [url=/c41412]Keith's[/url].
She acts like his fiancee but he doesn't really care about her like that.
A quick thinking woman who isn't prideful despite the fact that she's an elite.
She acts like a big sister to the protagonist.
